title: Black Rhino Painting vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Comparing Black Rhino Painting and Precision Paint Experts for an exterior repaint? See which exterior prep steps to confirm in writing before work begins.
h1: Black Rhino Painting vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Exterior paint fails from the surface underneath, so this guide focuses on the prep scope North Central Florida homeowners should confirm with every bidder.

questions: What exterior prep should a painting quote include?
Why does exterior paint peel in Florida?

sections.h2: An exterior bid is really a prep bid
body: Maybe your exterior bids include one from Black Rhino Painting and one from us. Instead of weighing one company against another, this guide weighs the prep written into each proposal, since a finish coat can never outperform the wall beneath it. Heat, humidity, afternoon storms, and pollen all test a coating, and the ones that fail early usually failed at the prep stage.

That makes the prep section the most important page of any exterior quote, and often the shortest. A line that reads "prep as needed" gives you nothing to hold a contractor to. A line that lists each step, the areas it applies to, and how repairs are priced gives you a real basis for comparison. The checklist below is the one we would use if we were collecting bids on our own homes.

sections.h2: Prep steps to confirm, one by one
body: Get every bidder to confirm on paper whether each of the following is covered by the quoted number:
bullets: Washing the whole exterior and allowing proper dry time
Scraping and sanding loose or failing paint
Mildew treatment on shaded walls and eaves
Rot and fascia replacement, priced separately
Re-caulking joints, trim, and window perimeters
Spot-priming bare wood and repaired areas

sections.h2: What our exterior prep days look like
body: Our house exteriors move through five fixed stages: a site visit, the written quote, dedicated prep days, the finish coats, and a closing inspection you sign. On that first visit the crew lead documents the siding and trim in photos and puts a moisture meter on anything doubtful. The prep stage that follows is the long one for most Florida homes: washing, killing mildew, scraping and sanding, setting nail pops, rot and fascia replacement, fresh caulk, and primer on every bare spot, all before a drop of topcoat.

Clapboards, lap boards, and trim boards all get 100% acrylic, and any sprayed section is immediately back-brushed or back-rolled to press the paint into the surface instead of letting it sit on top. The whole coating system is laid out on our exterior painting page; for the cleaning stage alone, see pressure washing and soft washing.

sections.h2: Signs your house needs more than a coat of paint
body: If you see blistering, peeling near the ground, soft trim, or cracked window frames, ask every contractor how they will address the cause, not just the symptom. Our guides on humidity and paint peeling and hidden siding moisture damage explain what to look for before you collect bids.

With a thorough prep scope, expect three to seven working days on an average house once washing and dry time are accounted for, ideally booked in the October-to-May season. Our exteriors carry a workmanship guarantee on paper lasting as long as 10 years, stacked on whatever the paint manufacturer separately warrants. Whatever bid you are reading, get the warranty language in writing before deciding.

When you request our estimate, the crew lead will walk every elevation, note problem areas in photos, and send an itemized quote usually within one business day. Compare its prep section line by line against any other bid, and ask questions about anything that looks thin, including ours.

faqs.q: Is Precision Paint Experts the same company as Black Rhino Painting?
faqs.a: No. Precision Paint Experts is its own independent, locally owned business out of Newberry, FL. Think of this page as a homeowner's checklist, not a review of anyone.

faqs.q: Is rot repair included in your exterior painting price?
faqs.a: Yes, when the walkthrough finds it. Each rotten fascia or trim section shows up as its own priced item in the quote, so you know exactly which boards are being replaced.

faqs.q: Can you paint an exterior in the summer?
faqs.a: Yes. The cooler October-to-May months are easiest, but summer exteriors go ahead with sunrise starts and the crew lead watching dew point and incoming storms on radar.
